lod_boundary: Equality chooses lower detail; stateless hard switch; no hysteresis or crossfade
distance: Euclidean eye to transformed world AABB center
bounds: Original courtyard indexed geometry bounds; transformed ellipsoid local[-1,1]^3 eight corners; same conservative bounds across all LODs
planes: Normalized VP row3±row0,row3±row1,row2,row3-row2; WebGPU clip Z[0,W], inside >=-0.0001 world
visibility: Frustum intersection only, not occlusion; tested51 only in culling modes. visible means submitted conservative candidate, not guaranteed visible pixels
batches: One object per indexed draw batch. Existing issue5 instancing experiment unchanged, not combined with this study. No GPU culling.
geometry_memory_scope: Shared static vertex+index buffers across both slots/all modes; 36-byte vertex, 4-byte index; excludes alignment, driver and pre-existing experiments. All three LODs retained, Core uploads this scene at startup even while another experiment is selected.
light: Fixed normalize(.75,1.25,.7), ambient.19 + Lambert.81; time changes camera only
timing: Native release llvmpipe CPU/GL blocking completion wall time and host CPU phases, not GPU timestamps/hardware/browser/Android FPS
acceptance_scope: Exploratory 512² whole-frame display-byte error: MAE<=0.5 and <=1% pixels have a channel difference>8. This does not guarantee invisible silhouette pop or stable threshold jitter.
